## Summary

Describe the change and the recovery problem it addresses.

## Safety impact

Explain how fail-closed behavior, target identity, manifest validation, and secret handling are preserved or strengthened.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests were added or updated.
- [ ] Existing automated tests pass.
- [ ] Fail-closed behavior is preserved.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic or fully sanitized.
- [ ] No secrets, production manifests, backups, real hostnames, network details, device identifiers, or private paths are included.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where needed.
